title: What Marketing Teams Build With AI: Campaigns, Dashboards, and Content Engines
summary: Marketing teams are replacing $30K/year in tools by building custom apps with AI. Here are the 6 tools high-performing marketing teams build — and how to ship them without a developer.
body_markdown: Airtable and Notion are database and wiki tools with limited custom logic. Blink generates full-stack applications: custom forms, custom workflows, custom user permissions, and custom business logic that can send Slack alerts, enforce approval steps, and trigger automations. Those are application behaviors, not database views.
